'''Ian Merriman''' (also published as '''Ian Merrimar''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Normal DPC]] on 24 February 2001 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|TIGIH]], according to Paul Motz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1799">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-my-cats-name-is-mittens-dpc-2-24-01d1799/ my-cats-name-is-mittens-dpc-2-24-01], DeckTech (Paul "Vollerian" Motz, 26 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-my-cats-name-is-mittens-dpc-2-24-01d1799/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Michael Raveling's report of the same event lists him as Ian Merrimar, 40th.<ref name="tr-d1814">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ normal-2001], DeckTech (Michael "Gilliatt" Raveling, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-normal-2001d1814/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
